site.name: Philosophy Explorer
site.tagline: Wisdom from the world's great thinkers

profile.name: Chris
profile.bio: Philosopher, curator, and lifelong student of ideas. I built Philosophy Explorer to make the wisdom of history's greatest thinkers accessible to everyone — from the agora of Athens to the seminar rooms of modernity. I believe philosophy is not a museum of dusty ideas but a living toolkit for navigating existence, ethics, and the good life. When I'm not reading Plato or Nietzsche, I'm writing about how ancient wisdom can illuminate modern problems.
profile.quote: The unexamined life is not worth living.
